summary: Russian drone and missile strikes targeted multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Dnipro, Sumy, and Chernihiv, causing infrastructure damage and casualties. Ukraine successfully tested an interceptor drone against Russian 'Geran-5' drones, and the US approved a $2.68 billion air defense package for Ukraine. A civilian exchange occurred at the Novaya Guta border crossing, with Ukraine receiving 15 civilians and Russia receiving 3.
key_points: Russian 'Geran' drones struck radar stations in Kharkiv region and a Ukrainian military command post at Voznesensk airfield in Mykolaiv region. (Source: @tass_agency/396210)
Ukraine successfully tested an interceptor drone that destroyed a Russian 'Geran-5' drone, marking the second successful use of the new system today. (Source: @UkraineNow/84191)
Russian strikes damaged nine civilian objects across four districts on Kyiv Oblast, including five warehouses, a garage, transport, and a residential building. (Source: @UkraineNow/84181)
A Russian attack on a high-rise building in Sumy may have trapped people under rubble, according to reports. (Source: @UkraineNow/84176)
Russia and Ukraine exchanged 18 civilians at the Novaya Guta border crossing, with Ukraine receiving 15 and Russia receiving 3. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33376)
The US approved a $2.68 billion air defense package for Ukraine, including S-300 systems, launchers, radars, and parts, funded by European contributions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33366)
Russian 'Geran' drones attacked targets across Kyiv, Dnipro, Sumy, and Chernihiv regions, with multiple interception attempts reported. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75181)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian drone and missile strikes continue to target Ukrainian infrastructure across multiple regions, indicating sustained offensive operations. Ukraine's successful testing of an interceptor drone against 'Geran-5' represents a significant development in countering Russian unmanned aerial systems. The US approval of a $2.68 billion air defense package suggests continued Western support despite delays in arms deliveries. Russian air defenses remain active, having shot down 288 Ukrainian drones in a single day. The exchange of civilians indicates ongoing diplomatic engagement amid hostilities.
sections.regional_response: European nations are contributing funding for the $2.68 billion US-approved air defense package for Ukraine, demonstrating continued regional support. Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs highlighted Europe's vulnerability to Russian missile strikes and inadequate air defense systems. The US has warned NATO allies of potential delays in arms deliveries of up to five years as it rebuilds its own stockpiles. These developments suggest coordinated Western efforts to bolster Ukraine's defenses while managing supply chain constraints.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian 'Geran' drone production facilities in Crimea are reportedly constructing underground workshops spanning approximately 42,000 square meters, indicating scaled-up manufacturing capabilities. Ukrainian military intelligence successfully targeted a Russian 'Geran-5' drone using a new interceptor system, demonstrating evolving tactical capabilities. Multiple drone incursions were detected across northern and central Ukraine, with coordinated attacks launched from various directions including Bryansk and Chernobyl regions. The frequency and geographic spread of attacks suggest a coordinated campaign rather than isolated incidents.
